implemented_capabilities: Source-code context and line boundary validation
Syntax validation for unified diff headers and line counts
Safety auditing: secret leak detection, weakening security rejection, arbitrary exec prevention
DAG attack-path-aware prioritization (entrypoints elevated to Priority 1, bottlenecks to Priority 2)
Shared root cause consolidation for overlapping file lines
Deterministic canonical serialization and SHA-256 output hashing
Distinction of lifecycle statuses: RECOMMENDATION_ONLY, SOURCE_VALIDATED, SYNTACTICALLY_VALIDATED, TESTED, APPLIED, VERIFIED

Anti-forgery live verification artifact auditing and protected provenance boundary (rejects caller-supplied boolean assertions, arbitrary hashes, synthetic fixtures, mismatched patch hashes, and unauthenticated caller-supplied LIVE_TARGET claims without exposing caller-controlled authority registration mechanisms)
supported_categories: SQLI (SQL Injection: parameterized prepared statements for Node, Python, Go, Java)
BOLA (Broken Object-Level Authorization: resource ownership checks for Node, Python, Go)
XSS (Cross-Site Scripting: DOMPurify and context-aware HTML entity encoding)
SECURITY_HEADER (Defensive headers: Helmet, CSP, nosniff, DENY, HSTS middleware)
SSRF (Server-Side Request Forgery: destination IP and metadata endpoint rejection)
PATH_TRAVERSAL (Directory Traversal: canonicalization and base directory containment)

source_context_validation_results.missing_source_policy: Explicit INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT status returned; no patch fabrication when source unavailable
source_context_validation_results.reference_diff_policy: Explicit RECOMMENDATION_ONLY status and IsReferencePattern=true flag when explicitly requested

dag_integration_results.breakage_narrative: Remediating perimeter entrypoint 'Public Web Perimeter Route' (REM-ITEM-FIND-XSS-JUICE-003) breaks path PATH-JUICE-CHAIN-01 at the boundary upon application, preventing traversal toward Juice Shop SQLite Database (NODE-SQLITE-DB) (Status: PROPOSED_PATH_BREAK; projected path interruption, patch not yet applied or verified).

known_limitations: Phase 7.3 is strictly a non-destructive remediation diff generator: automated patch application and live verification re-testing are outside Phase 7.3 scope. Generated diffs remain at PROPOSED_PATH_BREAK (BrokenPathCount = 0, EliminatedEdges = []). In accordance with the cryptographic provenance audit, self-contained SHA-256 integrity hashing does not authenticate artifact origin; VERIFIED_PATH_BREAK requires a future dedicated verification phase (Phase 9.2 Remediation Retest Engine) with protected, non-forgeable execution provenance.
AST-level syntactic matching requires matching runtime/compiler toolchains for full syntax compilation.
Reference pattern diffs for black-box findings are illustrative templates and require developer tailoring to the target repository.

regression_test_recommendations: Send authenticated request as User A accessing User B's object ID; assert 403 Forbidden
Send authenticated request as User A accessing User A's object ID; assert 200 OK
Request root endpoint and verify Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, and X-Frame-Options headers are present
Send boolean differential payload (' OR 1=1--) and verify target treats it as literal string with 0 injection matches
Send legitimate search query with alphanumeric characters and verify 200 OK with expected results
Verify user input is never concatenated into SQL query string and parameter values are supplied to database execution call
Inject payload <script>alert(1)</script> and verify payload is encoded (<script>) or neutralized in output
